title: Note sorter
desc: Sorts your notes into todos, ideas and thoughts, with you

variables.name: held
variables.desc: the id of the note at hand (none: none)

variables.name: bucket
variables.desc: the bucket picked for the note at hand

do.name: fresh
do.desc: takes the first note not weighed yet

due.desc: the unsorted note due first, if it's due, while you're at the computer and no question waits

do.name: oldest
do.desc: takes the unsorted note due first

weighing.desc: jev's bucket and how urgent it is, then whether to deal with it now

do.name: guess
do.desc: asks jev its bucket, and how urgent it is

criteria.Todo: Something the person needs to do: a task
criteria.Idea: An idea worth keeping: something to build, try or explore later
criteria.Thought: Just a thought, noted down to let it go: nothing to do, nor to keep

questions.question: Does this need dealing with right away, today?

set.name: note[index(note.id, held)].urgency
set.expr: 0.5 if urgent is None else urgent

do.name: now
do.desc: asks whether to deal with it now

values.says: 'This sounds urgent. Deal with it now?' if note[index(note.id, held)].urgency >= 0.7 else 'This can probably wait. Deal with it now anyway?' if note[index(note.id, held)].urgency < 0.3 else 'Deal with this now?'

asking.desc: its bucket, asked as sure as jev is of it

do.name: bucket
do.desc: asks its bucket, jev's picked already

values.says: 'Is this a todo, an idea, or just a passing thought?' if note[index(note.id, held)].guess is None else "I'm pretty sure this goes under " + note[index(note.id, held)].guess + '. Right?' if note[index(note.id, held)].conf is not None and note[index(note.id, held)].conf >= 0.7 else 'This looks like it goes under ' + note[index(note.id, held)].guess + '. Is that right?' if note[index(note.id, held)].conf is not None and note[index(note.id, held)].conf >= 0.4 else "I'd put this under " + note[index(note.id, held)].guess + ", but I'm not sure. Where does it go?"
